artworks.title: Portrait of a Yankee Peddler
artworks.description: The image shows a sepia-toned scene of a horse-drawn cart. The horse stands to the left, while the elaborately detailed cart is in the center. A man sits on the cart and another man stands beside it, holding onto one of the cart's contents. In the background, there are trees and wooden buildings, indicating a tranquil setting. The color palette consists of brown and beige tones, giving the impression of an aged photograph.

artworks.title: "The Yankee Peddler at the Parsonage"
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a house with a group of people and a horse-drawn wagon in front of it. The image captures the facade of a large, two-story house with a porch and an adjacent wooden structure. In front of the house, a horse-drawn cart is parked with various items in it. Surrounding the wagon, a group of individuals are congregated. Two large, leafless trees frame the scene. This is a stereoscopic image.

artworks.title: J. Frank Pope Ice Wagon
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a horse-drawn ice delivery cart. The scene features a horse harnessed to a large wooden cart with the words "J. Frank Pope Ice" on the side. The horse stands calmly with its head lowered. In the background, there is a small building with what looks like a shop front, alongside leafy trees and a nearby lamp post. The photograph is in sepia tone, giving it a historic feel.

artworks.title: Portrait of Plumbers
artworks.description: Two men are sitting on the ground. The man on the left has short hair and a mustache, holding a tool and wearing a striped shirt with suspenders. The man on the right has slightly longer hair and a mustache, and he is facing forward wearing a light-colored shirt and dark trousers with suspenders. Various tools and objects are scattered on the floor around them. The background is a decorated wall typical of studio photography backdrops, and the floor has a patterned design.

artworks.title: E. C. George & Co., Elmira, New York
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a building facade with three arched windows. The structure displays classical architectural elements such as prominent molding and decorative brickwork above the windows. The windows themselves are divided into multiple panes, and beneath these windows is a sign that reads "Daily News" and "Job Printing" with the name "George & Co." and the number "136." The photograph has a vintage quality, indicated by sepia tones and visible wear around the edges.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Wallpaperer
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing and leaning over a wooden plank placed between two barrels. He has curly hair and a mustache, wearing a dark waistcoat over a shirt and tattered pants. The man is looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. A chair with an object on it is next to one of the barrels. Rolled-up material lies beneath the plank. The room has plain walls and patterned flooring. The image is sepia-toned.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mailmen
artworks.description: The image features three men standing upright side by side. They have short hair and wear similar hats with decorative elements. They are dressed in matching formal outfits including jackets, waistcoats, trousers, shirts, and ties. Each man holds a stack of newspapers in one hand and carries a satchel over their shoulder. The background is a painted studio backdrop with a vague outdoor scene. The floor beneath them is plain with textured patches at their feet.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Roller Skate Rink Employee
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing on roller skates. He is posed with one leg slightly forward and his arms relaxed at his sides. The man has light-colored hair and a clean-shaven face. He is wearing a three-piece suit with a bow tie, a white pocket square, and a cap with writing on it. There is a chain hanging from his waistcoat. The background is a plain, textured surface. The photograph has a vintage appearance with visible specks and a dark border where "BAKER" and "COLUMBUS, O." are inscribed.

artworks.title: Evert Jansen Wendell
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a full-body portrait standing in a posed position, with his fists slightly raised. He has short, light-colored hair, styled with a side part, and sports a mustache. The man is wearing a sleeveless athletic outfit consisting of a tank top with a winged logo on the front and matching knee-length athletic shorts. He is also wearing dark flat shoes with ankle straps. The backdrop is simple and plain, with a soft gradient texture. The lower portion of the image includes the inscription "Pach Bros" and "New York."

artworks.title: Portrait of Night Soil Pumpers
artworks.description: There are four men in the image, standing in front of a wooden building. The first man on the left is wearing a hat, long-sleeve shirt, and dark pants; he holds a small bucket. The second man wears a similar hat, a light jacket over a shirt, and pants; he holds a large lever attached to equipment. The third man wears a dark suit, tie, and leans on a piece of machinery. The fourth man wears a hat, dark vest, patterned shirt, and light trousers; he also holds the large lever. The background shows wooden siding and a fenced area with grass.

artworks.title: Ed Charles, Railroad Engineer
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man wearing a checkered shirt, bow tie, white pants, dark shoes, and a cap. He is sitting on a fringed chair with one hand on his knee and the other on a table, holding a glass. An oil can is on the table and a small object is on the floor. The background consists of a plain wall with lace curtains.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Blacksmith
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing upright, leaning on a pedestal with a wrench in hand. He wears work attire, including a long-sleeved shirt, bow tie, apron, and sturdy shoes. The background consists of a painted backdrop with trees, creating an outdoor-like setting, with a plain floor and orderly surroundings.

artworks.title: Portrait of "Corn Solve" Salesmen
artworks.description: The image shows two men in full view. One man is seated with his hands clasped on his knee. He wears a hat, a light-colored shirt, a dark vest and pants, and one shoe off, revealing a bandaged foot. An object labeled "Corn Solve" is nearby. The other man stands holding a small bag with one hand and has his other hand in his pocket. He wears a hat, a white shirt, a tie, a vest, and plaid pants. A travel bag with clothing on it is at his feet. The background suggests an outdoor setting with foliage.

artworks.title: Portrait of Waiters
artworks.description: The image shows three men dressed in formal attire standing closely together. They have neatly combed hair, with two men having mustaches and one clean-shaven. They wear white suits with matching vests and bow ties, each sporting a boutonniere. The man on the right holds a cylindrical object in his left hand. In front of them is a small, round, wooden table with a decorative base, holding glasses and a carafe. The background is a plain, subtly decorative wall.

artworks.title: Portrait of Gamblers
artworks.description: The image shows five young men sitting closely together on the floor, playing cards. The man on the left is seated cross-legged, wearing a bowler hat and holding a cane, along with a cigarette. He is in a suit with a vest and a bow tie. To his right, two men are leaned over cards and money in the center. They wear dark vests, bow ties, and have cigarettes in their mouths. One is adjusting his cards. Standing behind them, a man in a dark suit with a lighter tie has his hand on a seated man's shoulder, with slicked-back hair. On the far right, another man is similar in dress and posture to the first, also with a bowler hat, vest, bow tie, and cigarette. The background features an ornate, patterned backdrop resembling a decorative setting in portrait photography of that era.

artworks.title: Portrait of Electric Light Installers
artworks.description: This is a photograph of tools, a ladder, and electric equipment in an indoor setting. A wooden ladder is leaned against a backdrop. On the floor are a coil of wire, hand tools like pliers, and additional equipment. One person is standing near the floor with more tools. The environment has decorative curtains and a floral design in the background. The photo includes ornamental text at the bottom indicating it is from Armour & Co. in Oswego, N.Y. The image is in sepia tone and reflects an early 20th-century style.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Telephone Lineman
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. They are facing slightly to the left, with their left hand on their hip and their right hand holding a coiled rope. The person has short hair and is wearing a brimmed hat, long sleeves, a high-collared shirt, suspenders, and a strap across the body, suggestive of a utility belt. They have a small satchel over their shoulder and there is another rope present. The background features classic architectural elements and the floor is covered in what appears to be hay or straw. The photograph is mounted on a card from a photography studio in Kewanee, Ill.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Ladies' Hat Salesman
artworks.description: The image displays four individuals in various poses, wearing vintage clothing and ornate hats. To the left, a woman is standing, holding a large hat. Next to her is a man in a suit and bowler hat. In the middle, a woman sits in a wicker chair holding a hat. On the right, another woman stands holding a mirror. A decorated backdrop with drapery and floral elements is visible.

artworks.title: "Dominic Parsons Hunting for Fossils"
artworks.description: The image features an older man seated on the ground working on rocks. He is in a three-quarter profile, facing right, with distinct facial hair, wearing a hat, suit, and holding tools. There are rocks, a wicker basket, and a scenic landscape background. The photo shows signs of age.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seamstress with Sewing Machine
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a side profile in front of a sewing machine. Her hair is mostly covered by a dark bonnet with ribbon details. She wears a long dark dress with full-length sleeves and a fitted bodice. Her hands rest on the sewing machine table, ready to operate it. The background is plain and neutral with a sepia tone. The woman is not wearing any visible jewelry.

artworks.title: Portrait of Doll Makers
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman with curly dark hair and a dark dress, holding a large doll in her lap. Beside her stands a man with short dark hair, wearing a light-colored shirt with overalls. The man has one hand resting on the chair and is holding two dolls in his hand. A basket at the woman's feet contains more dolls, with some placed in front of it. The background features painted trees and foliage, creating an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Portrait of Housekeepers
artworks.description: The image shows four women posing together. One woman stands at the back, while the others are seated on ornate chairs. They have styled hair, with some in buns and others with their hair pulled back. They all wear high-neck blouses and long checkered skirts. One woman holds a decorated hat, another a broom, and another a dustpan. They are set against a painted backdrop that resembles architectural elements, creating a formal studio portrait setting.

artworks.title: William H. Artzberger
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is standing in a slightly turned position with his right arm akimbo and his left hand holding an oval plaque with a painter's palette and brushes visible. The man has a pointed beard and mustache, a receding hairline, and short, dark hair. He wears a dark, buttoned-up coat with six circular medals and a bow tie. The background features an ornately decorated wall and architectural detailing.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright with a rifle. She is positioned slightly left of the image, with her body facing forward and her head turned right. She has short, curly hair, a focused expression, and is wearing a dark full-length dress with a high collar, long sleeves, a wide-brimmed hat, gloves, and a pouch or basket with birds. A dog is lying on the ground to her right. The backdrop features a tranquil landscape with trees, water, and hills in the distance.
